m: Fry the sliced chorizo in a dry pan until crispy and the oil runs red. Remove and keep the oil.
Season and brown the bite-size chicken in the chorizo oil. Set aside.
Cook the onion and capsicum 8 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika, chilli and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes and chicken and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the cream and spinach, add the chorizo back and season.
Cook the regular and GF pasta separately, toss each with the sauce, top with parmesan and parsley.
l: Keep a mug of pasta water to loosen the sauce when reheating.
g: GF pasta in its own pot. Check the chorizo label; most are GF but not all.
